# Introduction to Financial Ephemerides

## 1.1 The Market Hypothesis

Financial Astrology posits that planetary cycles exert an exogenous influence on market psychology, driving price trends in asset classes like Gold ($XAU$). This track specifically tests the claim that **Vedic planetary strength (Shadbala)** and **geometric signaling (Aspects)** can predict daily log-returns or volatility in the Gold market.

## 1.2 The Efficient Market Baseline

We contrast these claims against the **Efficient Market Hypothesis (EMH)**, which asserts that asset prices reflect all available information. If planetary positions are public information (which they are), their effects—if any—should be instantly priced in, leaving no predictive edge.

## 1.3 Methodology

We employ a **Vector Autoregression (VAR)** framework to test for **Granger Causality**, determining if planetary time-series provide statistically significant information gain for forecasting Gold returns beyond what is offered by past price history alone.
